articles.title: Reliance Retail Q2 profit takes a hit on Qcomm push
articles.description: Reliance Retail Ventures reported a significant drop in net profit, down 24.5% year-on-year to ₹2,619 crore in the last quarter. Despite this, revenue improved by 5.8% to ₹80,220 crore, largely driven by a surge in grocery sales. The company's profitability was affected by strategic investments and evolving festive season patterns, alongside rising finance costs stemming from increased borrowing and interest rates. Focus remains on improving transactions and business model adaptation.

articles.title: 80 feet above ground, 3 railway lines below: Nagpur Metro's 257-metre bridge uses construction technique that eliminates the need for scaffolding
articles.description: Nagpur Metro is constructing a 257-metre-long elevated bridge nearly 80 feet above railway tracks at Uppalwadi as part of its Phase-II expansion. The structure will cross three railway lines and is being built using the balanced cantilever technique, eliminating the need for scaffolding beneath it. The project is part of the 6.92-km Reach-2A corridor towards Kamptee.

articles.title: Airtel Africa Q2 profit rises 16% to $254 million
articles.description: Airtel Africa has revealed a remarkable 15.9% jump in its quarterly net profit, reaching $254 million, fueled by robust revenue growth. The total revenue escalated to $1.97 billion, showcasing a 25.7% rise in reported currency. Operating profit surged by 28.5% to $659 million, while customer numbers soared by 11.6%, pointing to the growing demand for data and mobile money services. The company achieved a record underlying Ebitda margin of 50.

articles.title: Indian Oil net profit triples YoY to 21,630 cr in Q2
articles.description: Indian Oil experienced a remarkable surge in its net profit, which soared to ₹21,630 crore for the second quarter. This growth can be attributed to elevated pump prices and government subsidies for LPG sales. In contrast, the same quarter last year showcased a profit of only ₹7,610 crore. Moreover, operational revenue increased by 29%, reaching ₹2,62,935 crore, with the firm's operating profit from petroleum product sales more than doubling.
